decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that stayed on the home page in 2024 and was presented as a flagship close to the core QA business, it likely exceeds or is near aspiration levels and merits continued support.

This software extends the established oncology QA offering and remained separately promoted across 2023 and 2024, so an expanding firm with innovation slack would likely keep it while learning about adoption.
The CT image quality phantom fits the firm's measurement and imaging capabilities well, and as a very recent 2024 launch it would normally be retained while early market feedback is still forming.

Because the mammography image quality phantom is more distant from the firm's traditional radiation therapy focus, its performance is more uncertain, but current organisational slack and the absence of a clear failure signal still favor keeping it for now.

This full field mammography test phantom is also relatively distant from the core offer and may face a higher aspiration hurdle, yet as a fresh 2024 launch it would likely be given more time before resources are reallocated.

The medical imaging QA instruments line builds on existing capabilities, was presented as a strategic focus in 2024, and in a growing, R&D-intensive firm such a flagship line is very unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
